answer: Operator liability pooling: each identity joins a mesa of shared collateral, and any proven sybil cluster triggers a full pool slash plus a fee multiplied by cluster size. Enforcement follows the operator's payout address, so a haven of fresh wallets still drains one treasury. This makes each fake identity cost the attacker the pool deposit plus the multiplied fee, not just a disposable wallet. A cedar of audit records links payouts to operators, so the penalty lands on the entity funding the attack.
